note: Three CD20-directed members, none approved: the DI-Leu16-IL2 immunocytokine (SCID Daudi model, phase I/II 2013-2016), MB-CART20.1 (phase I, published 2026) and CART20 (NCT02965157, pilot, no results or model published).
label: B-NHL (CD20 depleters: CAR-T, immunocytokine)

engagement.judgement: SCID mice lack T cells, so the lymphocyte expansion and cytokine rise seen in patients had no counterpart in the model; the ADCC assay was not repeated on patient samples.
engagement.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
engagement.note: SCID mice cleared disseminated Daudi lymphoma; the only mechanistic readout was in-vitro ADCC, which no trial measured. Route coded as the SC trial the program ran.
engagement.short: Tumour clearance; no human PD readout
engagement.quote: In a severe combined immunodeficient (SCID) mouse model of disseminated, residual lymphoma, anti-CD20-IL-2 immunocytokines based on Leu16 were far more effective at a dose of 0.25 mg/kg than anti-CD20 antibody given at 25/mg/kg
engagement.reason: No PD readout with human counterpart

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Products came from melanoma patients (NCT03893019), same MB-CART20.1 construct and process.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry for the co-culture track. Lymphoma-patient expansion was public in the ASH 2022 abstract (15 Nov 2022) before this 2024 co-culture, so the track's only comparison is a retrodiction; this opener stays untested (retrodiction is marked on the scored entry, as the lint allows retrodiction only on retro or contra).
engagement.model: MB-CART20.1 product co-culture with CD20+ target cells
engagement.note: Clinical-grade CD20 CAR T products expanded and released cytokines on CD20+ targets, antigen-dependently; no lymphoma patient data public yet. The co-culture was run after lymphoma expansion data were public (ASH 2022), so it predicted nothing before patients were measured; its only comparison is a retrodiction.
engagement.short: CAR T expand on CD20 targets
engagement.quote: All tested CAR T cell products were capable to translate into T cell activation upon engagement of CAR target cells, indicated by the increase in pro-inflammatory cytokine release and by the increase in CAR T cell amplification.

engagement.magnitude_basis: in vivo CAR T expansion (Cmax) vs in-vitro antigen-driven amplification
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level for both. NCT03664635 (first posted 2018-09-10) has no posted results. n=9, trial stopped early (COVID-19). Earliest patient date from the ASH 2022 abstract (read in full); the status source stays Kutsch 2026.
engagement.judgement: Judgement call: paired by me; CAR T expansion is read as the transgene product's own readout (proximal). The in-vitro amplification is a release/potency assay from melanoma-patient products. Retrodiction rule: the lymphoma expansion (Cmax higher in responders) was public in the ASH 2022 abstract (Blood 140 Suppl 1:12980, 15 Nov 2022) before the co-culture paper (epub 2024-09-25), so the co-culture reproduced a known result.
engagement.model: MB-CART20.1 product co-culture with CD20+ target cells
engagement.note: In nine r/r B-NHL patients MB-CART20.1 expanded robustly and dose-dependently (Cmax 125.9 vs 3.1 cells/uL), more in responders. Retrodiction: patient expansion was public at ASH 2022, before the 2024 co-culture; dated 2024, when both halves of the pairing were public (congress-abstract dating ruling).
engagement.quote: CAR T-cells showed robust expansion, with higher Cmax at DL1 than SDL (125.9 vs. 3.1 cells/µL).

dose.population: Relapsed/refractory CD20+ B-NHL, all rituximab-pretreated (SC phase I/II NCT01874288)
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Human RP2D 2 mg/m2 SC (MTD 4 mg/m2) came from 3+3 escalation.
dose.judgement: A mouse mg/kg dose is not an exposure target; converting it to mg/m2 would be my own arithmetic, which the rules exclude.
dose.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
dose.note: Mouse efficacy at 0.25 mg/kg; no human exposure target or tolerability margin was stated. Patients got SC DI-Leu16-IL2 after low-dose rituximab (50 mg/m2) B-cell depletion.
dose.short: Mouse dose only, no human target
dose.quote: In a severe combined immunodeficient (SCID) mouse model of disseminated, residual lymphoma, anti-CD20-IL-2 immunocytokines based on Leu16 were far more effective at a dose of 0.25 mg/kg than anti-CD20 antibody given at 25/mg/kg

efficacy.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
efficacy.note: DI-Leu16-IL2 at 0.25 mg/kg cleared residual lymphoma far better than 100-fold more anti-CD20 antibody.
efficacy.quote: In a severe combined immunodeficient (SCID) mouse model of disseminated, residual lymphoma, anti-CD20-IL-2 immunocytokines based on Leu16 were far more effective at a dose of 0.25 mg/kg than anti-CD20 antibody given at 25/mg/kg

efficacy.magnitude_basis: objective response in rituximab-refractory patients vs tumour clearance in mice
efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory CD20+ B-NHL, all rituximab-pretreated (SC phase I/II NCT01874288)
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry record read in full; no peer-reviewed paper found. ASH 2015 abstract (Blood 126:23, ScienceDirect S0006497118485126, read in full) reported 1 CR and 3 PR of 12; ASH 2016 abstract (doi 10.1182/blood.V128.22.620.620) ORR 31% (4 CR, 1 PR of 16).
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: dated 2015, the ASH 2015 abstract (Bachanova, Blood 126:23, 3 Dec 2015) that first made the SC responses public, under the earliest-public-date ruling; the registry results (2020) stay the status source. Single-arm design ruling: a response where the model predicted one is same. The mouse claim of superiority over rituximab is untested (no comparator arm).
efficacy.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
efficacy.note: Rituximab-refractory B-NHL on SC DI-Leu16-IL2: 3 CR and 2 PR among 23 evaluable; trial stopped early citing clinical benefit. Single-arm phase I/II with best overall response as primary endpoint and no success bar set in advance, scored on that endpoint against the mice's predicted response. Combination: each cycle followed low-dose rituximab (50 mg/m2) B-cell depletion. Dated to the ASH 2015 abstract (1 CR, 3 PR of 12).
efficacy.quote: Clinical benefit was noted in the earlier portion of the trial; hence, participants were not enrolled in 2 expansion cohorts and the study was terminated early.

patient_trials.quote: Clinical benefit was noted before the scheduled completion of the trial and the extension study was terminated early.

efficacy.judgement: Kept untested rather than pairing activation with response; the abstract reports no cytotoxicity or tumour model.
efficacy.model: MB-CART20.1 product co-culture with CD20+ target cells
efficacy.note: The co-culture read activation and amplification, not tumour killing or regression; the 2026 phase I had 56% ORR (3/9 CR), first public at ASH 2022.
efficacy.quote: All tested CAR T cell products were capable to translate into T cell activation upon engagement of CAR target cells, indicated by the increase in pro-inflammatory cytokine release and by the increase in CAR T cell amplification.
efficacy.reason: Model read activation, not antitumour effect

efficacy.confidence_note: Registry record has no posted results and no publication; the only patient data are the ASH 2013 abstract (Nakamura, Blood 122:21, 15 Nov 2013), not an admissible tier.
efficacy.judgement: IV dosing is its own track, split from the SC trial. The pilot's primary endpoint was MTD, response a secondary readout, and its results are public only as a congress abstract, so the mouse prediction stays unscored for IV.
efficacy.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
efficacy.note: IV pilot of DI-Leu16-IL2 after low-dose rituximab (50 mg/m2): 1 CR among 7 at 0.5 mg/m2 in an ASH 2013 abstract; no registry results or paper, and the primary endpoint was MTD.
efficacy.short: IV pilot unreported beyond an abstract
efficacy.reason: IV results only in an abstract

safety.population: Relapsed/refractory CD20+ B-NHL, all rituximab-pretreated (SC phase I/II NCT01874288)
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level; GLP toxicology of DI-Leu16-IL2 not found in public sources.
safety.judgement: Two grade 3 CRS DLTs at 6 mg/m2 are not scored as a model miss because SCID mice cannot show cytokine release.
safety.model: Disseminated Daudi lymphoma in SCID mice
safety.note: Efficacy model only; SCID mice lack T cells and cannot show the delayed CRS that limited the 6 mg/m2 dose.
safety.quote: Based on these animal models, DI-Leu16-IL-2 could offer therapeutic potential for patients with CD20 positive lymphoma.
